summary: Use oc explain ansibleautomationplatform.spec (and nested paths such as .spec.controller.route_tls_termination_mechanism, .spec.hub.storage_type, or --recursive) to discover CR parameters; configure components through the AAP CR's nested paths.
questions: How do I list AnsibleAutomationPlatform CR options with oc explain?

answer_card.title: Discover CR parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
oc explain ansibleautomationplatform.spec
oc explain ansibleautomationplatform.spec.hub.storage_type
oc explain ansibleautomationplatform.spec.controller --recursive
```
Component CRs (`automationcontroller.spec`, `automationhub.spec`, `eda.spec`) can be queried too, but configure through the AAP CR.
